## Collaboration note
[Closing lines in a request tone. The frontend describes the problem; the backend proposes the solution. Use one or more pushback invitations, in your own words, such as: "Let me know if this doesn't make sense for how the data is structured", "Open to suggestions on a better approach", "Not sure if this is the right way to think about it", "Push back if this complicates things unnecessarily".]
- **Invite pushback:** ask backend for input and alternatives.
- **Stay humble:** this is a request, not a demand.
- **Include context:** say why each need exists, so backend can choose a better approach.
